lesson.title: National rules, notification and reporting
lesson.summary: Locate national permission rules and trace each-use notifications through annual reporting.

prerequisites.reason: The national-law enquiry concerns whether and how the authorisation procedure is available. Notification is a separate duty and must not be mistaken for the prior authorisation.

blocks: This optional extension starts with **national authorisation rules**. A Member State may choose full or partial permission within the EU limits and must specify detailed request, issuance, exercise, supervision and reporting rules.

National law specifies permitted objectives and offences, and may be more restrictive consistently with Union law. Member States notify the adopted rules to the Commission within 30 days. The EU exception alone does not establish permission in an unspecified country.

**Each-use notification** goes to the relevant market surveillance authority and the national data protection authority under the national rules. It includes at least the paragraph 6 information, without sensitive operational data.
Notification is distinct from prior authorisation and registration. Sending one email to one authority cannot be assumed to satisfy all three processes or the two-recipient notification requirement.

The **annual reporting chain** begins with notified national market surveillance and data protection authorities reporting to the Commission. The Commission supplies a template including numbers and results of competent-authority authorisation decisions.
The Commission then publishes annual reports based on aggregated Member-State data. Those published reports must not include sensitive operational law-enforcement data.

Fictional Northbridge cross-border case: a team wants to reuse one country's permission elsewhere. Obtain each governing country's actual national rules and competent-authority procedure; do not invent a harmonised blanket permit.

Use a checklist with separate national-law, authorisation, registration, notification and annual-report fields. The core path does not depend on completing this extension; it offers a deeper administrative lookup method.
